title: Orbit-private frontier across View families
hypothesis: Across several target generators, a shared backbone plus a compact family View code and low-rank private residual reaches lower normalized operator error at lower complete serialized bytes than the best residual-only SVD bank at the same actual byte budget.

scope.normalization: For each task, structured generator update S and private update R have equal Frobenius norm 0.1*||W||F; R is orthogonal to the union of all structured candidate spans and to S. Target is W+(1-alpha)S+alpha R. Alpha is an amplitude mixture, not a private-energy fraction; report measured component and total energies.

family_definitions.ia3_diagonal: local input-channel activation scaling atoms W diag(e_j)
family_definitions.batchensemble_rank_one_tangent: first-order row/column rank-one modulation atoms diag(e_i)W and W diag(e_j) at identity; excludes second-order cross term
family_definitions.vera_fixed_random_lowrank: B diag(m) A with deterministic seeded frozen B and A, rank 4; B/A are paid shared state
family_definitions.shared_lora_lowrank: U C V^T with deterministic seeded frozen U/V, rank 2; U/V are paid shared state
family_definitions.givens_tangent: fixed disjoint Givens-plane generators J_ab W, local tangent at identity
family_definitions.boft_butterfly_tangent: fixed butterfly-plane generators J_ab W across log2(D) stages, local tangent at identity
family_definitions.family_neutral_orthogonal_operator: random matrix direction projected into the orthogonal complement of the union of all structured spans

controls: Mirror family code plus rank-q private residual
Native direct family coordinates plus the same gate and rank-q residual; identical serialization schema
Residual-only per-task truncated-SVD bank; choose the highest rank fitting within each candidate's actual serialized bytes

fit.procedure: Per-task deterministic least-squares projection onto each candidate family's analytic local basis; truncated SVD for the remaining matrix residual
fit.fit_compute: report least-squares/SVD elapsed time and operation count separately; no claim of learning efficiency or generalization

quality.primary: aggregate normalized squared operator error sum_i||Delta_i-Delta_hat_i||F^2 / sum_i||Delta_i||F^2
quality.secondary: relative error on fixed held-out isotropic probe vectors
quality.calibration: own-family alpha=0 plus full residual must replay with operator error <=1e-6

storage.authority: actual serialized NPZ inference payload bytes, measured for every candidate/control point
storage.precision: float32 tensors; integer IDs and schema metadata charged
paid_objects: all family state not deterministically reconstructible from W and paid seed
all residual factors or dense residuals
storage.independent_control: all eight target matrices serialized separately
storage.amortization: report complete bank bytes and bytes per logical task

report: family-code matrix decode MAC proxy per task load
private residual materialization MAC proxy per task load
dense matrix apply proxy per query
compute.fresh_or_audit: seeds 69011/69012/69013 sealed; do not open if native-family exact alias is observed

gates.useful_point: operator error <=0.02, actual serialized bytes <=75% of independent target bank, and decode+apply proxy <=2x independent full bank
gates.frontier_evidence: family coordinate plus residual beats residual-only at the same actual byte budget on at least three alpha values in at least two target generators
gates.mirror_specific: strict Pareto improvement over corresponding native direct family coordinate control
gates.failure: exact native family function/compute/byte alias without strict Pareto gain; fresh remains sealed
gates.not_established: own-family alpha=0/full-residual calibration or serialized replay fails

boundaries: This is a local linear operator-space screen; Givens and BOFT are explicitly tangent approximations, not full nonlinear finetuning.
All candidate families are cross-evaluated on all seven target generators.
The shared backbone is charged once for shared-bank candidates and full matrices are charged for the independent upper control.
The private residual-only control gets the largest SVD rank that fits within each candidate's measured payload bytes.
No language-model quality, learned adaptation, downstream generalization, or hardware-kernel claim follows.
Never tune after fresh access; if the exact native alias gate fires, leave fresh sealed.
